name: ACF Framework Charts — handoff inventory
note: Representative/illustrative exhibits. visualDataMode + disclosure define how each chart is presented. See README-agency-chart-handoff.md.

charts.title: Shape the Payoff
charts.frameworkClaim: ACF shapes exposure: the left side is capped, the right side is left free to run.
charts.readerTakeaway: Survive the left tail; stay convex on the right tail.
charts.chartType: Conceptual payoff curve vs a symmetric reference line.
charts.setupLine: The payoff shape the whole framework is built to produce
charts.explainerHeadline: The framework is a payoff shape, not a prediction.
charts.disclosure: Conceptual diagram · Illustrative framework exhibit, not historical data

charts.title: Bend the Tail
charts.frameworkClaim: ACF truncates the left tail and extends the right tail of the outcome distribution.
charts.readerTakeaway: Same center of gravity, deliberately reshaped tails.
charts.chartType: Conceptual outcome-distribution reshape vs a symmetric reference.
charts.setupLine: ACF reshapes the distribution of outcomes, it does not just chase higher returns
charts.explainerHeadline: We reshape the outcomes, not the average.
charts.disclosure: Conceptual diagram · Illustrative framework exhibit, not historical data

charts.title: The Window Opens
charts.frameworkClaim: ACF waits for setups where downside is defined and upside can accelerate.
charts.readerTakeaway: Patience through compression; size into confirmation; let the release run.
charts.chartType: Representative regime/path chart with a compression field and release marker.
charts.setupLine: Compression, then confirmation, then asymmetric release
charts.explainerHeadline: Convexity is a window, not a constant.
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

charts.title: Capital Has Weather
charts.frameworkClaim: Portfolio construction changes with the macro regime.
charts.readerTakeaway: You are not allocating in a vacuum; you are allocating into weather.
charts.chartType: Growth × inflation quadrant with a representative regime path.
charts.setupLine: Same assets, different regime, different behaviour
charts.explainerHeadline: The same portfolio behaves differently in different weather.
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

sources.label: Regime-agnostic allocation as a failure mode

charts.title: Govern the Thesis
charts.frameworkClaim: ACF is a closed-loop operating system, not a fixed set of weights.
charts.readerTakeaway: Every position is traceable to a thesis and governed by a tripwire.
charts.chartType: Minimal flow/loop diagram of the framework control system.
charts.setupLine: Thesis creates exposure · exposure creates risk · tripwires govern behaviour
charts.explainerHeadline: Structure flows from a thesis and is governed by tripwires.
charts.disclosure: Conceptual diagram · Illustrative framework exhibit, not historical data

sources.label: Order of operations · the closed loop

charts.title: The Hedge Broke
charts.frameworkClaim: Stocks and bonds are not always true diversifiers.
charts.readerTakeaway: When inflation drives the regime, the hedge can fall with the risk.
charts.setupLine: Indexed total return through an inflation shock: stocks, bonds, and the 60/40 blend
charts.explainerHeadline: The hedge can fail with the risk.
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

sources.label: Bloomberg US Aggregate total return (ICE proxy)

charts.title: Correlation Turns
charts.frameworkClaim: Stock–bond correlation changes when inflation becomes the dominant stress.
charts.readerTakeaway: The diversifier did not disappear. The regime that produced it did.
charts.chartType: Rolling 24-month stock–bond correlation with a non-rectangular inflation-shock background.
charts.setupLine: Rolling 24-month stock–bond correlation across an inflation-shock window
charts.explainerHeadline: When inflation runs the regime, correlations flip.
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

sources.label: Bloomberg US Aggregate total return (ICE proxy)

charts.title: Inflation Was Bigger
charts.frameworkClaim: CPI alone does not capture the full inflation story.
charts.readerTakeaway: Consumer prices roughly doubled. The assets that store capital did far more.
charts.chartType: Three normalized index lines with a gap area between assets and CPI.
charts.setupLine: CPI, housing, and a broad-asset proxy, each indexed to 100
charts.explainerHeadline: The CPI tells one story; capital saw another.
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

sources.label: S&P/Case-Shiller US National Home Price Index

charts.title: The Bill Came Due
charts.frameworkClaim: Debt and interest burden reduce policy freedom.
charts.readerTakeaway: For decades, debt rose while falling rates hid the cost. The cost is no longer hidden.
charts.chartType: Stacked dual-panel chart, shared timeline. Top: debt/GDP. Bottom: net interest/GDP.
charts.setupLine: Federal debt and net interest, both as a share of GDP, on a shared timeline
charts.explainerHeadline: The cost of debt stopped being free.
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

sources.label: Federal debt held by the public / GDP

charts.title: Path Changes Everything
charts.frameworkClaim: Same average return, opposite sequence, opposite survival outcome.
charts.readerTakeaway: Withdrawal-phase capital does not care about the average. It cares about the order.
charts.setupLine: Identical return set, opposite order, $1.0M start, $40k annual withdrawals
charts.disclosure: Representative simulation · Built to show path dependency, not a historical backtest

sources.label: Identical annual return set, opposite order

charts.title: Survive the Path
charts.frameworkClaim: Upside only matters if sizing lets you survive the path.
charts.readerTakeaway: Volatile assets can still compound — through, not around, the drawdown.
charts.chartType: Invested-vs-value representative path with drawdown shading.
charts.setupLine: Cumulative invested versus portfolio value, with drawdown-from-peak shaded
charts.disclosure: Representative framework exhibit · Sources support the underlying concept

sources.label: Constant DCA, no rebalancing, no leverage
